purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/レセプト) processing for Iwate prefecture wide-area federation (岩手県広域連合) diagnostic fee claim submission
purpose.summary: SOKATU0815 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that generates or updates insurance claim (レセプト) data for a specific prefecture-level wide-area health insurance federation. It reads receipt DB update files, aggregates claim counts and amounts by insurer and public expense category, and produces output for submission. The program handles multiple revision cycles dating from 2008 through 2017.

notable_features: 30 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPRCF010, CPPTINF, CPHKNNUM, CPSK1001-1903, CPSK2007, CPSK2010, etc.)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
UNSTRING on COMMAND-PARAM for parameter parsing
OCCURS tables for public expense (公費) aggregation up to 100 entries
High comment ratio (32%) with Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments
Revision history embedded in comments spanning 2008-2017
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
GOTO usage (3 occurrences, noted in revision history as replacement for PERFORM)
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (decoded as latin-1), causing Japanese text to appear as mojibake in the snippet. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~95KB total; full procedure division not visible but structure is clear from indicators (132 PERFORMs, 9 CALLs, 30 COPYs).
